text: Started with calamari, it was perfect. We had the Dynamic duo and worth every penny! Everything on the plate was amazing, and the mash potatoes were the best I have ever had! We also ordered the scallops with the Caribbean jerk sauce, I am not a fan of super spicy food, but I actually enjoyed it. Crown apple and sprite was a great way to end our meal!
A great little hidden gem in Florissant!! Great for takeout especially during the pandemic, this local spot has a little bit of everything for everyone.

Each experience we have at Revery is wonderful and unique! It's on point with any of Indy's trendy spots.

On our most recent visit, we sat at the back bar for dinner and drinks. What a fun experience watching the bartenders create all the amazing drinks. We also enjoyed chatting with them about their remarkable selection of spirits. We found a few new bourbons and we'll definitely be back to sample more.

This place is delicious!! Very clean. And great service! Big portions. 
We got tiki masala and chana masala and asked for extra veggies in the Chana masala. Plus. garlic naan. Oh and free rice pudding. So yummy!! We will be coming back!!  Five stars for sure!!

I always feel so nostalgic about Pat's!  It was my first cheese steak in philly when I first started traveling for work. I remember researching how to order and what to order. And it was the best experience of my traveling experience!  Fast forward to today, almost twenty years later and I still love to eat here. It's  definitely changed over the years, but still hits the spot. I will definitely be back again and again and again.

Being the staple that Pat's is, it was the first place that I ate at when I visited Philly.  I stopped by at around 9:30 am.  Yeah, sort of an odd time to go for a steak sandwich but I wanted to avoid the long lines and be able to find parking.  And I managed to do both.  

As of now, there are almost 4,000 reviews on Yelp and Pat's is currently at 3 stars.  I'd say that's about right (I'm giving it three stars as well).  My sandwich was fine but it wasn't amazing.  I probably didn't have the freshest meat in my sandwich as I went really early in the morning.  It was fairly dry and didn't taste like a whole lot.  But the fries were fresh and I put some hot sauce on my sandwich so it all worked out.  

There is some outside seating in case you want to dine on location.  You also need to know that it is cash only.  The staff was friendly enough. 
 
I feel like eating at Pat's is much more about saying that you've eaten at Pat's because it's an institution as opposed to eating there because it's the steak sandwich in town.  I mean come on, Rocky ate here.  And it's marked by an engraved tile on the floor.  All of this being said, you've got to eat here at least once.  I think I'll check out some other sandwich shops around the city for the sake of comparison.
Best poke bowl I've had so far, and the stone fruit tea. I'll be back soon for the spicy Sriracha bowls.

I'm super glad I took the time to book a table here!! Prior to my arrival in Indy! I could not wait to try their "fiery" shrimp cocktail which packs plenty of "zing" at this Downtown landmark! Yes, you can take the cocktail sauce home with you! 

I came early to dinner and enjoyed a pre dinner cocktail as well in the 1933 Lounge! Gerri was an excellent server with great recommendations for enjoying a bourbon cocktail! Woodford Reserve #13 was smooth and sweet! 

I was thrill to enjoy a ribeye steak the way it was intended! last night delivered a "memorable" dinner in a white-tablecloth setting with "top-notch" service from Steve! My mouth watering steak was cooked to perfection and complimented nicely with the sautéed cashew green beans! I followed it up with an amazing dessert! 

No doubt, you'll "pay handsomely", but I'm sure most agree it "surpasses expectations" from "start to finish.

 There is no doubt I'll come back again next year and enjoy another mouthwatering steak from this landmark establishments

The food here is amazing. I had the Butter Chicken and it did not disappoint. The color of the dish was so vibrant; similar to the rocks in Sodona. I ordered spicy and it definitely had a kick. I will definitely be back here many times!!!

The Creperie has always been one of my favorite restaurants to eat at with friends. The workers are always so nice, the restaurant is so clean and such cute decor, and most of all the strawberry Nutella crepes are amazing!! I've never had a bad experience here even during lunch rush which is surprising because they get very busy. This is definitely one of my favorite places to eat if I'm looking for something sweet or somewhere to grab a bite with friends.

F*** this place. If I could give them 0 stars I would. I ordered DoorDash at 11:07, days it'll be at my house in 64-74 minutes. I continue to look at the app and all it says is "processing". The dasher changed twice and after 2 hours of waiting I get a cancellation message. If you're not going to deliver the food past closing, which I didn't know they closed at 12 because their ordering was still open, DONT TAKE ORDERS TOO CLOSE TO CLOSE! I got off a long shift at work and just wanted to have my food there when I got home. Worst experience I've ever had.

This place couture tp knock it out of park! Great service great staff great food and very nice staff and service is always great and pick up to go is quick love love love this Sushi Thai...great salads but wished they would serve a bigger portion! I love me some ginger salad.

I hadn't been here in a few years but tonight I had the most amazing cheeseburger with fries than I've had in a long time.  The burger was cooked done but oh so juicy, run  through the garden, my fries were perfect in every way and popping hot. The waitress Cindy, was friendly and attentive, we didn't want for anything. Loved sitting under the stars with friends enjoying our meal.

This place is awesome! Best New Orleans food outside New Orleans, perhaps even better. Everything from the appetizers to the main dishes, and dessert was phenomenal. I have only good things to say. I will definitely be coming back to check out the rest of the menu.
Outstanding bbq. We stopped here specifically as we passed thru Nashville.  Haven't found anywhere in Nashville that's better!
Really good authentic Vietnamese. Full menu for takeout and very reasonable with fast service!! Very large portions.

True Italian market in the middle of STP. I sincerely doubt anything here is bad. The sandwiches are fire! The prepped dinners are top notch. If you're going for lunch, be sure to allot a few extra minutes. As one would expect from a local favorite spot, it can get a bit crowded.

A lot of the staff really sucked. First the server tried to give me a go plate after telling her twice I was dining. Obviously she was too lazy to go get plates. Taco shells were cold, so she warmed tacos and threw them on my plate. Not good! Not good. Had to do a do over at another restaurant. Bar was good. Probably won't go back though

Get the Felix on whatever you order!!! That sauce topping is out of this world. I would order it by the gallon if they would sell it to me. I got the salmon Felix and the salmon was cooked to absolute perfection. The staff was also friendly and attentive.
Wonderful dinner at Tinker Street. The Brussels sprouts and stroganoff were amazing!  We loved starting the evening with sparkling wine.
We LOVE the food here. We used to come every week when we lived across the street. Now we travel to still come! We have never had a bad experience!

Had a great lunch here at Cabbys.   Our server Taylor was a sweetie! Great drinks too.  Also, the rum bucket was good as well, if you like sweet. Appetizers were delicious.  We had boneless chicken strips... calamari, and onion rings.   I also had the crab cake sandwich. Omg! Fantastic. When I'm back in Florida, and in Clearwater, we will definitely be back. Oh yah, great view from the outside third floor balcony, where we actually sat. Thanks for the good eats

Best treat after a sunny afternoon paddleboarding (from next door's MMY Yoga!). Seasonal flavors worth multiple repeat visits! We shared a large of Sweet Butter Corn, Honey Lavender, & Almond Coconut Chocolate Chip. Last year we loved the blueberry nectarine cobbler but it was sold out this visit :(
Online ordered Reginelli's! Super convenient delivery as well. The tortellini was amazing. One of my favorite dishes from here. I really would like to try their Baked Brie Calzone special soon.
Really felt like sushi a few weeks back so tried this spot out and man did I not know what I had been missing. Really hit the spot, fresh and reasonably priced.

Pull up not busy there was not one car in the drive thru, get to the speaker, lady is so rude just giving so much attitude, we get to the window to pay, shes on her phone laughing with her coworkers, we pay (she snatched my card) , go wait for food, get food, go home, and what do i find no ranch & my burger was supposed to have bacon it didnt have it but they gave us like 20 marinara sauces & ketchups that we didnt ask for, just extremely disappointing that not only was i greeted with rudeness but she read my order back to me and still got my order wrong when we were the only people there.. i think the ladies name was Jodie

Everything I've ever gotten from here is delicious! Chicken quesadillas, shrimp and grits, grilled chicken Caesar salad, chicken tacos, and grilled mahi mahi and veggies! (Just to name a few) The service is  professional and prompt! A great choice for lunch or dinner.

This is our go to Asian food. Have to admit we haven't tried a lot because we have favorites and are having trouble bypassing them to try a different dish. Staff is fast & friendly and price is amazing. Portions are generous.

Most lack luster Cinco de Mayo ever! Watered down margaritas and super oily chips followed by dried out carnitas tacos simply ruined the evening. This place has consistently been like my Uncle - the one I should have stayed away from in the first place!! Avoid if possible. Save your pesos for another deserving restaurante!! Adios creepy Uncle!

This was our first POBOY in New Orleans.  We had just finished our 3 hour ghost tour of the city and were starving.  Our guide told us NOLA was a place to try.  A small joint with a few booth tables and a short counter we strolled in with the kids and ordered at the counter.  There was an intoxicated young person at the counter with their hood over their head leaning on the counter.  Pretty funny how this individual sat quietly the entire time we were there sleeping.  This is definitely a place to stop at after a drink because they are open late if not all night, I'd have to check that fact again.  We had fried shrimp and fries, grilled cheese and fries, spicy shrimp poboy and fried oyster poboy.  It was very good my only suggestion is that my spicy shrimp was VERY spicy and I like spicy, so you may want to try plain and add your hot sauce.

Was good previously but lately not so good. Last week- ordered and paid for brisket with other items take out. I get home no brisket but pulled pork. Burnt brusell sprouts. 
This week I ordered a 20 oz porterhouse cooked for takeout. I realize take out of a steak is dicey but I literally live half a mile away. Way over cooked and like leather. For 35 bucks I expected better. It's not like I was late because I had to wait for the order. Need to learn to cook steaks. The sides lately are way overcooked.

Worst manager! Went in for Cinco de Mayo after using their app to join the line. The app said there were 3 parties ahead of us and the wait line was 3-13 m. We arrived and checked in at the podium only to be told there was 20-25 min wait.  Walking thru the restaurant I noticed plenty of opened tables. 
I returned to the podium and asked if we could be seated at one of the many opened tables and order drinks while we waited since the bar area was full. 
I was shocked when I was told the manager decided not to occupy the tables because the kitchen was short staffed and running 25 mins behind.  I can understand the kitchen running behind but why in the World would you not allow a party that has no problem waiting to sit down at an open and order drinks. 
So done with this location. 

Update: I did hear from Chili's Corporate office by email and USPS. They apologized for the incident and we will give this location another try very soon.
Came here for the Crawfish boil. Food good, price good, service kinda on the rude side.

I came here because the Cuban Sandwhich was highly recommended!!! However, the Picadillo empanadas were impeccable and stole the show. I absolutely loved everything here. The black beans and Spanish rice were delicious and so were the yucca fries. The service was amazing and I felt right at home. We had amazing service and the food spoke for the whole restaurant. Next time you're here please try the Empanadas they're a MUST!

Party Fowl was our first Hot Chicken experience in Nashville and it did not disappoint. We came to enjoy some chicken, drinks and college hoops, and Party Fowl fit the bill perfectly.

The chicken was spicy and tender and came served on texas toast, which soaked up the spice and flavor of the chicken. Dill pickles and cole slaw rounded the meal out nicely.

We also placed an order for the bourbon glazed beignets, which unfortunately never arrived. When we checked on the status with our server, we learned that the fire had been turned off for the night (this was at the end of the night). That was a bit of a disappointment but an honest mistake, and our server discounted our bill and bought us another round of drinks on the house. So that cured our spirits. I sampled a few of Nashville's local beers and my friends had the watermelon frosé, to which they gave two thumbs up.

Overall, Party Fowl offers a casual vibe with good food and drinks for catching some sports (or just catching up) with friends.

Ordered from HAO Wah via Uber Eats last night & very impressed!  Delicious big portions.  Had the Pad Thai, Beef & Mushrooms, Chicken & Broccoli & Combination Fried rice.  Also ordered some crab rangoon & egg rolls.  The crab rangoon was just like I like it- not sweet. We'll be frequent orderers.

I'm starting to see a trend here with my recent foodie adventures in the Tampa Bay area...apparently I REALLY, REALLY like noodles. I guess that's why I decided to hit up Asiatic Street Food & Noodle Bar. Here's where it gets interesting though: I actually did NOT get a noodle dish. That was my intention at first, and perhaps it was this spot's name that grabbed my attention. Regardless, it got me in the door. It was my first time in Ybor and after walking around a bit I was absolutely famished. Again, my intention was initially to go in there and chow down on some noodles. Then I realized the menu was pretty darn extensive with dishes I had never even heard of before. I love that because it gives me an opportunity to expand my horizons. One thing this restaurant did that I appreciated was that it highlighted some of its best dishes. This led me to Phad Basil. Basil, peppers, beans, and ground chicken topped with an egg in a savory sauce with a side of white rice called my name. Reasonably priced and generously portioned, this unique dish was just what I needed after galavanting around Ybor. Believe it or not, there was so much food that I had to take some home for the next day. It proved to be just as good as it was served fresh. Next time you're in Ybor, you gotta check this place out!

I went in for happy hour to have draft Dos XX.  The draft was down the happy hour specials in menu were $3 off, BUT the bartender said the menus were wrong and the special was $2 off.  I ended up ordering the house margarita and trying the chips & salsa.  Margarita was ok, but chips store bought out of a bag and salsa tasted like tomato paste.  Needless to say I won't be going here for happy hour again.
The atmosphere and decor was nice.

This place. The food. The company. The drinks. 
Definitely a local spot. If I lived in or around Newtown, I'd be eating and drinking at the Temp.

I don't know what's going on with Taco Bell's in the Riverview and Brandon area but the wait lines in the drive-through are ridiculous. We have a child that has grown fond of your chicken quesadilla. Every time we treat him to this, we spend over 20 minutes in your drive-through lanes. Corporate has to take notice of this. Put in an additional lane, aff more staff, do something! This his wait is something we shouldn't have to endure.
Really good solid food here. The Fried chicken rice with basil the crab rangoon. All good! They have many more delicious things but those are my favorites.

First things first, do your research. I didn't realize this location didn't sell alcohol, so I was super bummed when I tried to order a cocktail I saw on the website, and I couldn't get it. :( Everything was great though. Our server, Camille, was awesome. She was very informative about the menu and answered whatever questions we had with ease.

I ordered the Crab & Avocado Toast, and it was as amazing as it sounds. I believe it's a seasonal item, so get it while you can. I got my eggs scrambled, since I'm not much of a runny egg lover. Throw some hot sauce on the eggs and the avocado toast, and drift away to heaven. It was delicious. My wife ordered the Chickichanga and she said that was also amazing too! The next time I visit St. Louis, I'll be sure to stop by one of these locations.

Let's just say I'm a frequent flyer to this location since it's near my home base. Tonight my girl friend and I walked in around 9:15pm to find the place to look like a mess. 90% of the table were not wiped down and there was no customers in the restaurant. Regardless we were hungry so we continued to make our order. When we said we were "eating here" the server let out a huge sigh! As we move down the line he says there was no more lettuce nor sour cream, again we didnt mind because we were hungry. As we found a table to CLEAN UP OURSELVES a horde of people walked in, the line was back to the window. By this time it's about 9:30, I get they close at 10 but still the place was not presentable. Anyway, I saw the same server reach into the fridge and give numerous other customers lettuce. This man lied to me and we felt cheated of our meal with our missing ingredients. I expect better from my homebase Chipotle. We were pretty disappointed with the whole experience. None the less well be back but not anytime soon.

Best muffaletta sandwich ever . 
The bread is so light and fluffy, hands down best sandwich in NOLA

I'm quite a fan of Bryn & Daynes and their healthy fast food concept. The food is clean and I know I'm eating healthy on the go for it. 

I have enjoyed their self service point of sale option to take my time in looking at the menu and not feeling rushed into a poor decision. 

I also now have a spot to go to for an alternative to ice cream (especially during whole30...) thanks to the banana whip and many more new whip options!

This location in particular is amazing to go to during spring and summer. The open air window treatments, plants galore making you feel as if your are in a greenhouse and with little to no noise thanks to it's location within a small development right outside the plymouth meeting mall makes it an ideal spot to meet up with friends and relax before a busy Sunday morning grocery shopping!

Stopped in today for lunch. We were seated quickly by a very nice woman upstairs and outside. We did have kids with us and I felt this restaurant at lunch time was family friendly. Not a ton of options on the kids menu. I get most people don't bring kids here. But they had 3 basics good enough.
I have to say I'm giving this restaurant 5 stars because the food we had was all amazing. We ordered red beans and rice, pesto ya ya I believe, shrimp alfredo and a chicken sandwich. Everything was perfect even the fries were good.
We did order some oysters that never came and our server was a little slow. But still 5 stars. 
Pricing I felt was standard.
Great food, great service, fresh & clean. Everything on the menu you was great but what really stood out was the crab fries. YUM , 10/10 recommend.

Very nice place. I'm surprised by the yelp ratings on this spot.  
I found this place to be exceptionally good. Out door seating in this pandemic world. Makes this a very nice place. 


The all day breakfast menu.  And the lunch þ dinner menu has so many great choices. I'm told the menu changes often but can't confirm this.  
The staff is very helpful and friendly. Wish I remeber the waitress name to give her a special shout out. She was new and very attentive. 
The menu has something for everyone of many eating habits.  
I can tell you the chicken salad sib is exceptionally good. No added salt needed. The cut fine cold slaw was very tasty. The homemade chips was perfect touch to this dish. 

The food is reasonably priced and suitable for many occasions.  
 
This place I'll make a point to come back to.

If I could give zero stars I would.  This store has no customer service skills at ALL. In fact I stood at the front waiting to be acknowledged for 5 minutes. Then I finally had my order taken, I stood there for another 10 to 12 minutes. Watching the employees play on their phones,  walk back and forth doing absolutely nothing. I watched the lady on the grill play on her phone, then proceed to grab a pair to wrap a burger. All while not Sanitizing her hands at all.  She grabbed lettuce and the salt after having her phone on her hand.  Watching employees walk to the back of the store with nothing in hand, then walk to the front with nothing in their hands was not amusing at all.  While I stood there waiting.  What amazed me the most, is that my bag of food was sitting behind the counter.  I was waiting for a drink. That was the worst experience. I'm amazed that McDonald's workers want that $15 an hour.  For what? To play on their phone?

While I did once get a chance to dine-in at Foghorn, my last few experiences have been take out during the COVID era.  I'm happy to report take-out does not take-away from the food!

Foghorn makes an excellent chicken sandwich.  It comes on a soft bun with homemade pickles on top.  You get a choice of a side - either more pickles or cole slaw.  I mix it up every visit.  They also give you an option on sauces, although I almost always go with their herby ranch.  The sandwich and side should fill you up.

They also sell fried chicken by the half or whole.  Again, sides included.  I think the whole chicken is a bit pricy, but I will again give them credit for how tasty it is, especially hot out of the oven.

Pre-Covid there was plenty of space to eat in and enjoy.  Now, you can still sit in (capacity limited) or pick up without going in (via their window).  I say I end up grabbing food here every two to three weeks, so I think that means I recommend it =P
We had dinner there Sunday evening. Service was great, thanks Taylor, and her cocktails were on point! I absolutely recommend the scallops!!

I ate here with my friend one night after work and we sat outside in the beautiful patio area outback. It was gorgeous! Our server Sharon was absolutely amazing! So friendly and accommodating. We ordered calamari and the eggplant rolls and both were absolutely delicious. Their homemade sauce is incredible! I have been telling everyone how delicious the food was but also how amazing the service was!

This bakery is a standalone next to a strip by the Hidden Treasure Thrift Store, however they do not share the same parking lot as there are concrete squares that separate the lots, I'm unsure why. Once we entered, it was a very nice and ambient place. The selection at 5:30pm was very limited so I can't speak on when they first open up but we got sugar donuts at $1 each, which was okay. It was very clean and the lady behind the bakery counter was very friendly. She gave us the donuts in a styrofoam container and I would've been okay with just some wax paper and a napkin. They also have drinks, snacks, chocolate but we decided to pass on that, maybe next time!

This is my second visit here even though the food was not great the first time.  I enjoyed  the atmosphere and thought I would give it another try. The first time here I ordered the lamb rack and it was not good at all, I was so disappointed. We're back again and had the crab dip for a starter. It was okay, but I wouldn't order it again. The scallops were absolutely delicious, but they left the muscle on them which was interesting...I'm still on the fence about this place.

One of our favorite spots. They recently changed their name to Cali from Ciccios. Don't love all the menu changes that keep happening. Our favorites are the Spicy Brazilian and the Fajita Bowls. Recently tried the Thai bowl and was a little disappointed. The live music is excellent. They have this guitarist/vocalist names Connor Z that is fantastic. Great brunch spot as well.

Love this place food is always great the the staff is very attentive. They make recommendations and they are very friendly. I called one time and they didn't answer they saw my phone number and called me right back.
Love the food! Staff is awesome. Great location and clean restaurant. Me and my wife love this place and we eat here one or twice a week.

We live in strange times right now with the quarantine due to Covid. I was in the mood for a good margherita pizza so I decided to try this place via Door Dash. It was pretty good pizza but not the best I've had. The crust was a bit too thin and flimsy for me. And not enough mozarella distributed uniformly on the pie. But I do commend Pizzeria Vetri for donating pizzas to Penn Medicine during this pandemic. So I applaud them for their sense of community.

Champ's diner reminds me of comfort food that you crave on a Tuesday summer afternoon. Abby and Zummy my server were AWESOME!This is probably one of the rarest severs who I have seen who actually enjoy their job. The diner is small with chalk writing so it gives off a casual vibe. I order the chicken and waffle and it was GREAT! The portion size was extremely filling! The chicken was seasoned extremely well like your mom was in the kitchen cooking for you! There was a Sweet chili sauce for the chicken which went well. The chef for this particular dish did fantastic. I also tried from my friends the eggs which were good, sweet potatoes fries which are a Staple for me and they were great. I would 100% be visiting again! If you go ask for Abby and zummy !

Third or fourth time coming here and I just am always satisfied. Their black bean burger is amazing, their chicken tenders are so yummy and fries are so crispy and delicious! Best place to grab a bite when at the beach.always hits the spot! Love mangos. Their mango frozen daiquiri is so bomb. Just wish they had Maybe a larger menu option but still sooo yummy! Def go' here!
Best breakfast , lunch  and chicken bowl in town ! Service is very friendly , love the korean owners here ! Will be coming back here again!!! Definitely Recommend this spot :)

Thanks Ocean World for keeping the sushi coming!  A couple nights ago I had had enough of my own cooking and gave in to my craving for sushi and shumai!  I ordered online and my favorite spicy combo (Bob's roll, California roll  & a Hoosier roll spicy style) was ready to go on time at the front counter!  Grab and go yummy sushi for me!

It seems like a lifetime ago,
But this once was my full time job. 
I'd leave each day coated in cheesecake. 
Like a sweet, dessert-covered slob. 

Some call this the poor man's fine dining. 
I'd say that that assessment is right. 
Bring your middle class family 
For a special occasion or date night. 

Yes, the wait is always long
And no, they don't take reservations. 
So bring a healthy appetite. 
But also bring your patience.

The prices can seem a bit high. 
But think of each entree as two meals. 
Don't eat all that pasta in one sitting. 
Imagine how much better you'll feel. 

The menu is ridiculous large. 
Some don't even make it past the apps. 
I would recommend the you order 
Their amazing Thai Lettuce Wraps

Sure the plate takes up the entire table
And you have to eat with your hands. 
I tell myself it's somewhat healthy 
And that it won't affect my waistband. 

Their cheesecake was always my downfall. 
It was literally part of my job to try it. 
No matter what I did, it was always:
"Oops, there goes my diet."

Their original is simple and tasty. 
And I love the caramel pecan turtle. 
Thankfully, I lost all my "factory weight".
Otherwise I might need a girdle.

My husband and I have eaten a lot of pho. We've had pho in and around Philly, New York, LA, New Jersey and Chicago. We love the different restaurants and what they offer. I must also mention that we are partial to chicken pho or pho ga. Pho-ever Yours is located in a cute little section of Narberth with parking in the rear. Unfortunately we did not love their pho ga. This place did not offer fish sauce, dried chili paste or even chili garlic sauce to allow you to add layers to the pho but only offered hoisin and sriracha. I could not taste the star anise or any other deep flavors in their broth either; they simply provided a clean, basic broth taste which was just okay. I'll agree with previous reviewers who have said the portions are small for the price. The grilled shrimp summer rolls were just okay as well. I'm glad we visited this place because the staff and neighborhood were friendly and quiet but there would not be a reason to return. Nothing memorable about the pho ga itself.

We were fortunate enough to visit mid week and they were able to seat us immediately. The staff was fantastic and all worked together to make our experience top notch. Shout out to JT for the mustache game and high level of common sense. The food and coffee were delicious, I can't give this place enough compliments!
This place is amazing! We ordered the chicken tikka masala, garlic naan, and chicken biryani. All were SO delicious that we ordered two days in a row!! Highly recommend!

I heard this place was doing a family pack special for takeout during the pandemic, so I know when decided to order this with my roommate. He managed for two dinners. We can order through Uber eats but I realize that if you can support the restaurant directly you should go there to pick up instead. There are cute drawings on the pizza boxes with crayons for kids. The pizza was still barely warm. However the reheating instructions were just right and it was delicious. The fennel and sausage combination had acid cutting through the sausage's heaviness which I loved. My roommate's favorite is pepperoni and while I usually don't choose that flavor, it was very good. We both sung the praises of the meatballs, which were out of this world delicious. The tiramisu was very good, on par with restaurants. And while he avoided the Caesar I found the dressing extremely flavorful.

Wow! Worth the wait. Our group of 4 had a variety of foods. Loved my blue corn grits with poached egg, bacon and chives.  Friends had the waffle and the Danish pancake.  Pancake was awesome! Maple bacon more lime a pork belly. Good flavor but you had to cut out a lot of fat.

Takes a little time to figure out the menu. Server good at explaining options. Coffee good. Good pastries! Nice place for when weather warmer and can sit outside. 

Would return!

I love seafood. Red Lobster's seafood is okay, but it's bit too pricey for the quality and serving portion they offer in my opinion. Their staff are friendly, service was great with welcoming atmosphere. I wish we don't have to pay for the tablet's game.

Placed an order via DoorDash. One of the sandwiches was prepared completely incorrectly and missing a side. The rest of the orders were clearly thrown together carelessly. The dry spice on the vegan chicken was just thrown on top, so none of the spice was spread evenly or on the second piece on the bottom. DoorDash gave me a refund for the restaurant's mistakes. Will not ever order from here again.

Meatball sub was good, pricey.
There's a sign for pickup orders but none to order.  So don't just go in and sit down and expect to have a waiter.  You have to order at counter.

Just had the absolute BEST pizza ever.  We ordered a Cheesesteak pizza and wings. When we called we were offered curbside pick up but we went in to pick up our order.  
Service was awesome !!! everyone was very friendly and our food was Delicious.   We will definitely be back very soon !!!!! Best pizza EVER !!!!!!!!!!!

Great breakfast spot right off of 86th street. I ordered the byo skillet with a side of pancakes & a pina colada mimosa. Everything was delicious. No wait time at all for a Saturday. Staff is friendly & wears masks. Will be returning for more.

New owner makes amazing food and a lot cheaper 
Authentic flavors and amazing Greek fries
Was really impressed with the food.   The salsa was really good and I had the smoked pork green Chile enchiladas which were excellent.  Definitely a step above the typical Mexican restaurant

Flamestone is a solid option for date night and special occasions. I've been coming to this location for some time now and I must say they have been consistent every time. 

The food is consistently good as well as the service. They brought out a slice of chocolate cake with a candle for my Son's 15th Birthday, its all in the details. Don't sleep on Flamestone.
This carls jr sucks ass. Says they open at 6:30 but the 2 women working are always late.

Got a fake apology from the server Asia and an even worse apology from the owner. Tourist trap. Crap food and cheap service. I will never recommend this place to anyone! Save your money and go somewhere else!
Overly seasoned extremely hard fried chicken. In the attempt to eat local I stopped in. Velveeta shells and cheese is not mac and cheese. I may give it another shot but not anytime soon.

Saw a huge highway billboard advertising fresh fried chicken here, and that happens to be one of my biggest weaknesses. I wasn't disappointed. Large pieces. Juicy. Nicely spiced. Corn muffins! This company does have an anti-gay history but I'll be damned if I'm going to let that get in the way of the best fried chicken in the STL area.

This is a fancier place than we anticipated on our first visit. I would suggest business casual dress for lunch time. 

The food tasted so fresh! The Homestyle Pot Pie was creamy and flavorful, yet mild. It had a complementary medley of vegetables and chicken. Most dishes here were strangely unique and adventuresome - but I say that in a good way. The Pot Pie is what you would expect and should expect - it is for the diner in the group who likes delicious yet predictable.  

The Spinach Pappardelle is adventurous. It includes a roasted chicken  piece that is really flavorful, alongside green pasta noodles, spinach and roasted tomatoes. The tomatoes were so good. Each bite was like an adventure for your tastebuds. I am a classic girl so at first the chicken was everything I desired but after eating 50% I was sampling the pot pie next to me! Ha! I would say my eating companion and I had the perfect balance of experience in ordering an adventure and a staple then splitting our meals. 

I also enjoyed a delicious Riesling glass of wine. 

The waitstaff was helpful, kind, and professional while not being overbearing. The ambiance is outstanding - the decor is beautiful. 

The lunch price was very reasonable considering the quality of the food and the experience of eating here - under $50.00 including the tip. For perspective we ate at BJ's last night and ordered a small pizza and salad with no drink and our check was $50.00 to eat at a pub covered in noise and TVs. 

I would revis
This place always has good food with large portions. I always use Uber eats which delivery the meals are always hot.

Decided to try take out during the stay at home orders.  Tried to order online, but couldn't use website coupon, so called it in.  When we got home, found out our pizza was overcooked to the point of being burnt.  Made for a dry, charred, tasteless lunch.  If you order for pickup,make sure you open the box and check before you leave.  We won't be going back.
Wow! What outstanding service. We were greeted by a cheerful host, and the waitress was attentive, polite and fun. Even the manager stopped by to check on us. Five stars from beginning to end!!!
Entree ordered was good. Drinks were good. Nice spot for a good meal. I usually don't ordered burgers or sandwiches at restaurants but the southern chicken sandwich did not disappoint.

Still amazing years later. Today I had 3 oysters and fisherman stew. I looked like such a novice because I put all the toppings on the oysters. I wasn't sure how to eat them LMAO. But it was delicious and smell free. The fisherman stew consisted of salmon, shrimp and mussels in a tomato broth. It was a light enjoyable flavor, the tomato and onions could be tasted with I throughly enjoyed. 


I originally came in because I checked the menu on yelp and it said shrimp and grits with an egg lol. SALTY because that was not on the menu but I still loved what I got.

My date and I had dinner at Gray & Dudley last Saturday night. We arrived around 1730, without a reservation, and were greeted by a most hospitable maître d' who seated us straight away.  The ambiance, appetizer, entries and service were second to none! My date had the seared catfish with creamy grits, fried brussel sprouts, brown butter and onion jam. I had the roasted chicken with spiced sweet potato, charred onion and peanut gremolata. OMG! For dessert, the sweet potato cheesecake was a most unexpected treat, rounded out with sous-chef Christopher's donuts. To say our visit was just a "meal" is an understatement... it was an "experience". We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and will definitely be going back! We tip our hats to executive chef Matt Bell, and his sous-chef Christopher Hull and our servers, Jenny and Madeline. You all really knocked it out of the park... Well Done!
This place is outstanding!    One of the best meals I've ever eaten in Nashville.  Absolutely spectacular.  And the people that work there are great and super kid friendly.  We will return!

Prices are competitive with other restaurants in the area, but quality is not. Wait staff was dismissive and my table was regularly looked passed. I had to ask explicitly for chip refills twice. Disappointed in my visit.

Coyote Crossing is a restaurant with great potential, but they are failing right now for their quality of service, quality of food and most of all, responsibility to their customers, i.e. price gouging. Apps were fine and served fairly quickly. Dinner orders were taken. I asked for corn tortillas instead of flour tortillas and was told they couldn't make that change. Fine, I asked for corn tortillas on the side and turned my quesadilla into tacos on my own. It was supposed to be duck and mango - I couldn't find a single piece of mango in the dish. The frijoles, a staple food in a Mexican restaurant, were inedible as they were overly salty. In addition, tables were not, in my opinion, spaced far enough apart. The table behind me was only about 4' away and, when leaving we walked between two sets of table in an aisle a wheelchair would not have fit through, so nowhere near 6' apart. The last two things: our waitress asked if we wanted anything else with coffee - as far as I can tell, they don't serve dessert, so we thought that was an odd question. We also asked for tea which apparently they don't serve. We did ask if we could have hot water as I always carry decaf teabags as many restaurants don't have decaf tea. We were told they didn't have hot water. Huh? Put a pot on the stove. Heat a cup in the microwave. It's not rocket science. We were served two cups of barely tepid water. Finally, without asking and WITHOUT TELLING us, they added a 25% tip to the check. I had seen on

We came to Taxman for our first venture out of the house a couple weeks ago! It was my first time here and I loved everything! I have always been a huge fan of sour ales and never knew Taxman carried them. I tried Consolidation, and hands down it is now in my top 5 favorite sours! I loved it so much I came back a week later and got a growler fill. Also, margarita spin-off is another phenomenal sour (lemon-limey) that you can buy in cans.
As for food, we started with a soft pretzel which came with some super delicious dipping sauces. The pretzel was not too crispy and not too soft, cooked perfectly! Then I got the chicken sandwich, and my boyfriend got the smash burger. We both subbed for fries and all I have to say is the portions are HUGE (never a bad thing)!The chicken sandwich had nice breading that was crispy and not chewy or soggy. My boyfriend loved the how cheesy the smash burger was. The beef is from Turchettis Deli in Fountain Square (big fans of Turchettis so this was a huge plus!). Everything had amazing flavors from the beer to the food. 
The outdoor area is amazing, well spaced, and has sun shades throughout. Occasionally the train comes by but that is nothing they can help. They also allow dogs on their patio! 
You can park on Delaware street, and I believe there is a joint parking lot for all the businesses in CityWay (I always walk so not for certain). 
As for how they handled sanitation and safety during Covid, I felt super safe the whole time! The tables wer

Highly recommend this place if you're looking for quick, customizable, delicious bagels. As you can see from my photo, they do not skimp on filling aka a bagel lovers dream. The breakfast potatoes are your typical breakfast potatoes, nothing special, but they do shell out a hefty portion! Only issue was I ordered an everything bagel, and I believe they must've run out, but I wasn't notified, and I realized once I was home that my bagel was whole grain. Not a big deal, the bagel was delicious anyway!

The food is good. Disappointed in the cooks without masks over their noses. Two of them only had it over their mouth; one girl hurried up and put it on when I walked in and the other guy just went about making food. I said something and the cashier was blasé. I know everyone has covid fatigue, but they require customers to wear masks, and they should def be preparing food with masks on. 

Trying real hard to support local businesses during this mess but come on, please comply with guidelines and keep your customers safe. :(

Full disclosure: I went to this institution months ago while I was in the area. I only ordered naan and kebabs. The naans aren't really naans, meaning that they are more a khamiri roti but they weren't bad at all, they were made fresh and had decent taste. 

The kebabs were surprisingly very good. The spices were perfectly distributed and harmonious. Classic Pakistani spices which are staples in most dishes are all there. They were cooked very well and not raw. Most importantly they are cooked from raw unlike most other places which keep them half cooked and fully cook them when ordered. Also, very important is the fact that the kebabs smelled good and did not give off a stale meat type of smell. 

Definitely will try again if in the area.
$4 breakfast taco is tasty, filling , and Fresh Fresh.  Soft taco with pimento cheese, bacon, eggs, mushrooms.  Prepared fresh

I've dined at this restaurant twice now and both times I have had very good experiences. I actually had the same server both times and she was an absolute delight. She was very sociable and recommended really good dishes to us. I particularly liked the mushroom soup... Doesn't look like much when it comes out, but the smell of the truffle oil was so good. Then I took a spoonful of it, and the soup far exceeded my expectations. It was perfectly creamy and smooth, and the truffle oil made it a thousand times better. I forgot what it was called exactly, but if you just ask your server about it, they'll likely know what you're talking about. I like their pasta as well; I think I got the clam pasta and that was great, just a little expensive, but that's to be expected in these kinds of establishments.

Service has been great both times that I have been with my family. The ingredients used for their dishes combine for an experience that is hard to find in Nashville. The wine options have not disappointed and the ambiance is great. They made great use of the adaptive space.

I was impressed that they used HUGE prawns for the fried rice. The garlic sauce was amazing. I use it as a dip sauce for the prawns instead of pouring all over the rice. I wish I had taken a picture of the food. Also the staff named Victor was very kind and attentive. Highly recommend!

Valentine's Day service was not good.   It took a ridiculously long time for our entrees to come out.  When I finally asked where our entrees were after seeing a table who came in after us get served first, our waiter completely brushed me off.   Entrees finally came out, and they were room temperature at best.  Steak was just okay. By the time the lobster got served, it had gotten dry and pricked me in the throat.  We had to ask for melted butter.  Dessert came out literally less than 5 minutes later by one server.   Then our other waiter tried to bring us another of the same dessert and looked confused when I said we already had it.   Meh to the entire 2.5 hour dinner experience.

This is my favorite place for breakfast in Northern Indy. They have a great menu with lots of options and affordable prices. They serve breakfast and lunch during the whole day. My fav lunch sandwich is the California crab cake one and for breakfast I usually get the old school. They also have a very unique decoration. It can get pretty crowded in the weekends.

I'll start by saying that my colleague and I didn't get to this place for our main dinner because we found another joint around the corner but along the way noticed the $2 beer advertisement in the window. So we politely made a screeching turn into this place to give it a whirl. We both saw the wood fire pizza oven as soon as we walked in and smelled the goodness thereof. We knew we had made a mistake by eating somewhere else. 

The beer selection is wide and includes a really good local IPA -cant remember the name after I'd had a few- we did decide that out of greed and the need to try some stuff we ordered the calamari which was freaking great! The fried citrus slices added a little mm-mm good to the dish and the creamy sauces weren't too tangy nor too weak. Not to mention a great outdoor seating situation next to the river. I'll be back here to try a few more things. Several items looked very good on the menu. 

Finally my favorite moment was noticing how they deliver the bill in a book/novel instead of the little billfold thingy. Please world encourage more reading and mental independence! Our awesome server chose to bring my bill in my childhood FAVE - The Cat In The Hat!!!! I lit up like a child!!!
I came due to a friends recommendation...Good food and the service was just as much...I will be returning

I wish they were consistent! Blind Onion has been hit and miss the last 4 times we have ordered takeout pizza. The last time it was so undercooked and doughy that it gave us stomachaches. Toppings have been sparse as well. If I wanted a cheese pizza, that's what I would order. We usually order the Hawaiian and the Generals (basically, a combination pizza). We also get the Garlic Cheesy bread. Some days it's the best pizza you've ever had and others it's a huge disappointment. Most recently, it was the latter so I'm not sure if/when we will try again.

Loaded with tender LAMB chops and couscous are creamy and with mild flavours!
Fantastic!

The best, most garlicky yumminess ever. My only gripe is they don't do social distancing well and that kids are usually running around being really loud. But when it comes to the food and service, 0 issues. Yum yum yum

I have lived in Exton about 7 years and this is hands down my favorite place for food, drinks, staff... EVERYTHING!!! Also I am from NJ and they have PORKROLL   which is hard to find in this area for some reason. I meet friends, family or work people here and am never disappointed. The patio (dog friendly) is big and so nice when the weather is too good to be inside. Food is amazing! Staff is consistent and they are all so great including the owner. If I had to say anything to improve it would be getting rid of the basketball game. If you haven't been here yet you should GO!!!

Bar atmosphere.  Service good.  Great vegan options.  Jackfruit taquitos were great with the ranch dip.  Seitan is some of the best I've ever had. My omnivore friend really liked trying new types of food.  I'd definitely eat here again!

I love this place. The "Over the Rainbow" is my favorite thing on the menu: Tuna, Salmon, Krab, Mango, Edamame, Sprouts, Masago, Sesame Seeds with
Sweet Yuzu Sauce. It is huge - if you are not all that hungry, you will absolutely have left overs. The fish is fresh, the rice is amazing, and the accompanying Yuzu sauce is absolutely delicious. They really focus on quality of ingredients!

Quality: 5/5
Price: 5/5 (the best $12 you will ever spend)
Location: 5/5
Service: 5/5
OVERALL: 5/5
Al Pastor tacos are the best!  My favorite thing from here. Their green salsa that comes with the tacos is so delicious.

The drive thru could be crawling with the covid!
Both workers sitting so they are under the plexiglass guard! No gloves no masks! 
It's not just gross it's your life!! Just don't !
The food never ever disappoints! The chicken noodle soup is so good. Everything is ready fast and right. The owners are so nice and helpful. They will do whatever it takes to make you happy.

Wow first time here and definitely will come back. The food is very good. Monica was our server and she was perfect, when we come back we will ask to sit in Monica's area if she is working. She was incredible.

This Missing Brick is a fun little spot off of 65th and Binford that you would miss if you were not paying attention. This cute little spot boast a small but very tasty selection of specialty pizzas. There is a small beer and wine selection. The pizza is freshly prepared, so there is a little wait, but nothing a glass of wine couldn't help pass the time away with. 

I went with friends and picked the seafood trap pizza. I loved that they collaborated with other black own chefs for their speciality pizzas. The trap pizza was so good. The crust was crispy and the toppings plentiful and flavorful. The pizza is a little expensive for $16...But I would still comeback for more!

This place is truly phenomenal. Not only is the customer service top notch, as they answer any questions with genuine care, the food is some of the best vegan food I've ever had. I'm gluten free, and they had a whole separate menu full of great options! They take care to curate good food from clean and well sourced ingredients. This is a must stop for any person (vegan or not) in Philadelphia!

Sad to give this place a 3. My parents and I were in town just for the day flying out of Nashville and we were looking for some good bbq. This wasn't our first choice but the place we wanted to go to was closed on Sunday and a person walking on the street said this place was good. So we went to the restraunt and surprisingly was sat in less than 15 min with full service while there was a line out the door. Someone came out and said "is there a party of 3 here?" And we were the only ones so they took us to be seated. (If you don't have full service it is cafeteria style) The waitress who was friendly took us to the back and sat us near a bar which was perfectly fine. We got our drinks and ordered our food and this is where it began going downhill. The food was not hot. My mom had asked for extra crispy fries and they came out cold.  She also asked for a straw and we ended up having to go to the bar because she forgot. For the food being not very hot it was still decent and would probably come back to try it again. Another aspect of the experience was that the waitress took our food order, it came out extremely fast, and then she was no where to be found after. It took us an extremely long time to get the check or a refill so we went up to the bar and had a bar tender get us our tab and refills. This wouldn't have been that big of an issue if she had told us that's how it works but there were no expectations set. 

As far as the ambience, it was amazing! The outdoor seating was

11 out of 10. This was our first visit. Customer service was exceptional. Very attentive and met all of our needs. The person who appeared to be the manager was very active on the floor visiting every table ensuring that all the guests were extremely happy. We love that kind of interaction from the management. The food was wonderful with nice size portions. Cutely decorated. We will be back!

As a local I rarely eat out in the Quarter because when I do, I'm usually pretty disappointed. Not the case at all with Coterie! I had guests visiting from out of town and they of course wanted to spend time In French Quarter. We went in on a Saturday morning and all left 110% satisfied! Not only was the food incredible but the service was nothing short of amazing. It seemed somewhat busy but that did not stop our server, Brittany, from giving my guests and I perfect service. She was not only on top of everything  but was wonderfully charming, personable and most of all, hilarious! She made sure we were taken care of and made sure we had a great time. I will not only recommend this restaurant to my friends but I will also recommend they ask for Brittany while dining in!

Came here a couple months ago when there was no virus situation.

Upon walking in the greeter was pretty nice to us, and gave us a seat near the window. This is a tapas place (obviously), so you're just gonna order a bunch of small dishes. We got the potatoes (patatas bravas), skirt steak (picanha), baba ganoush... among others. The potatoes are extremely good and everything is really solid value. I wish I could come again to try more things, but I don't live in St. Petes, so... opportunity is limited.

In short, this is a really nice place.
Small place with great customer service and food. This little gem was amazing. Loved this omelette and the cucumber lemonade. If I'm ever in New Orleans again I will definitely stop by here again.

Well deserving of this 5  rating especially given that our new reality dining out is now takeout.  I couldn't wait to get home with this delicious smelling dinner of mine!  Ordering was simple and they offered curbside pickup ... note they definitely took safety measures (mask/gloves).  I've got one word that describes their food - FLAVOR!  If anyone is a fan of Guy Fieri Mi Mex is Flavortown for sure. I talking every single item we ordered was packed w/flavor and when I say that I mean deliciousness.  I ordered the carne asada w/the roasted jalapeños n cactus.  Wow can I say mind blown it was so good!  The kids got chicken, beef and al pastor tacos.  It was funny to see my teenage son's expression w/every taco he ate. He was like mom seriously best chicken taco I've ever had and then he ate the pork followed by the beef.  Each time same statement but he said out of the 3 he said his favorite was the beef and then caveats that it's because he just loves beef!  My daughter agreed that this place was fire! My only ask (if you're reading this owners of Mi Mex) please add elote to your menu! Honeymoon can't wait til we can dine in and have the mouthwatering dishes straight from the kitchen to our table!  For the ppl reading this review order and get yourself some or a lot of this really awesome Mexican food NOW! Totally worth it and you won't be disappointed

Man... I just had the worst wrap of my life, and my coworker threw away his steak sandwich because the meat was still raw. The fries were wet (?) and completely undercooked. This is terrible, terrible food. I'm actually in shock at how horrible this experience was. 

1 out of 5 stars is too nice. 0 out of 5 would still be too nice.

this restaurant has been on my mind for a while now and i finally got the chance to visit. the food was amazing and the service was great. claire took great care of my friend and i :) would definitely visit again!

This was my favorite place until they started playing loud music. Hard to have a conversation anymore, which cancels out good wine and good food. There's not a single corner where you can hide from the speakers. In the summer you can at least escape the noise by sitting outside and smelling the fumes of cars passing by, but no such luck in December.  

I'd be happy to delete this review if owners show me marketing research proving that most patrons enjoy loud mainstream music blasting into their ears while drinking good Spanish wine.

I was craving some good tacos and Walked into this place after seeing the reviews. Spot on. Cant believe i lived in bensalem for years and never tried this little restaurant at the back of a grocery store.
Good food! Custom made burritos and nice customer service! They also offer vegetarian and vegan option plus wheat tortillas.. we will definitely be coming back!
Loved everything about this hotel. The staff was friendly, speedy check in and check out, the breakfast was amazing! Definitely recommend this hotel

Ordered a Tom Yum soup and a papaya salad this evening to go. Got home to see the soup was LOADED with squash, broccoli and carrots and there was hardly any soup in it. 
The papaya salad was full of carrots and tomatoes that were must have been old as it were stinking.
We threw away both!
I will never ever go there again. Think they've gotten too big for their boots or folks just don't know what good Thai is. I've been to Thailand a dozen times and do recognize good Thai from ultra mediocre.
It's time we get a proper Thai place Nashville!

I wish I could like them more because I live literally next door to them. With so many seafood options all on the same block and in this area you have to do something different or do it better to stand out. I can't say that anything here stands out to me. The food and service are both fine. This location definitely gets packed especially on the weekends. Prices are a little higher than their competitors across the street. 

Decent food but many other seafood restaurants in this city/area that do it better.

Much better than the Sparks location across from Sierra Sid's. These people are courteous and friendly, unlike nasty-as-hell Tina in Sparks. Not sure why BK keeps lousy employees when there are obviously people who are professional and know how to treat customers.

Trying to support local businesses in this time of covid 19. One staff member behind the counter had gloves on. Not wiping down buzzers. Touching the food baskets with full ungloved hands to the customer. Putting to go orders in bags with ungloved hands touching everything. Handing glasses of tea and water with no gloves. Then second day in a row that they messed up our order. The blatant disregard for our health as well as their staff is really upsetting. There are plenty of restaurants in this city that have implemented procedures for the safety of their patrons and their staff. We will not be returning. Support local restaurants that appreciate your business!!!!

Not what it used to be.

Pros: The service is still great. From the hostess to the wait staff, to the support people,  they are all still good. The place is still nice and clean and the outdoor dining is nice. The price drop on the new menu is more affordable.  

Cons: The new menu is more like Fergs, Hooters or Ale House than the old menu. There is only one steak available and very limited mains. Nothing really reminds you of the old Stillwater. Our entries were over cooked and over salted. My wife fish was dry . 

Our waitress made up for the food. Stillwater just isn't special anymore.

Funny thing, I opened up my yelp account to review Chop Chop Shop and I already had a review started from the last time I had it (guessing 6 months ago). Unfortunately my previous review was 5* while this one is 2*.

I ordered online and saw many of the menu items I used to order were not there. Ok...I can adjust. Instead of the combo karage chicken and pork i went with the katsu chicken. The chicken itself was not bad (a little salty) but the meal/bowl just seemed to be missing something. It was literally
just a chicken, rice and sauce bowl. I missed the power greens, scallions, etc from the old menu.  

Also ordered the fries which I regret. They were very soggy and too "potato-ey" if that makes sense. 

Used to be a favorite place of mine to eat. Hopefully this can just be blamed on Covid and things will return to normal eventually.  I'll update my review pending the next meal I have here.

Super slow service just to place an order inside. There are only four people ahead of me and it took 25 minutes to reach the cashier. Why do people wait until they are standing in front of the cashier to look at the menu and decide what they want??? That's just stupid and selfish especially when there is a long line behind you!
Glad we found this place. Stopped in because of Club Savor. Large portions. Good happy hour. Homemade salad dressing. Vegetarian options. Personable staff. Checks all of the boxes for me.

We have been to the Waffle House every time we visit this area. The food and prices are decent and the staff is friendly. 
It's usually pretty busy for breakfast and you'll often have a short wait to sit down but in the afternoon it's not as full and worth the visit just for the original double cheeseburgers.

I recently had a business lunch at this gastropub & truly enjoyed the wings and macaroni & cheese that I ordered. The wings were delicious, the service was wonderful, the waitress was friendly, & my business lunch was quite successful ! I would recommend this gastropub to anyone who wants a nice meal. :)

We've been to the other pho bangs and they're great! This is our first time at this location and during the pandemic. First off, the food was on point. Only thing that took me by surprise and was quite disappointing was the fact they didn't have pho ga (chicken), which all the other locations have. I'm not sure if this location ever had it or this is a new thing. I got chargrilled pork vermicelli instead, as did my husband. My biggest complaint is how they were with phase 3. Too many tables, not enough spacing. It was packed!! Then, so many customers were walking around without masks on: walking in, walking around, checking out, walking out. Nobody said anything. And then the cleaning and disinfecting of the tables was mediocre at best. I'm giving them 2 stars because the while the food was good, the operation as a whole dropped the ball. We more than likely won't come back to this location.

Today I decided to try Masterpeace Grill for the first time. I ordered take-out, I ordered the buffalo wings hot and a grilled chicken Caesar salad. The wait time for the food was quick which was good and the cashier was nice. I was not impressed with the food unfortunately, esp. the salad, which consisted of romaine lettuce, tomatoes (which I asked them to add and they did at no additional charge), grilled chicken and Parmesan cheese which was the grated/powdery type from the container. The tomatoes were soggy and warm so I ended up removing those from the salad. The lettuce was fresh and crisp but the chicken was bland. I didn't end up enjoying or finishing the salad, sadly I was disappointed. The buffalo wings were ok, but not crispy, very sub-par. Maybe ordering other items on their menu would improve my view and give me a better experience, they are known for their cheesesteaks. Not sure if I would try this place again.

This is one of my favorite spots to go for an ice cream treat or lunch with my kids. The waitstaff has always been been polite and ready to please.
    I haven't been for dinner yet, but the menu looks great. Our lunch has always been done perfectly, so I'd like to go for dinner, regardless of the bad reviews, perhaps after a matinée.
And, do I need to mention... their ice cream is the best!  I don't even mind the long lines at the window in the summer.

I got take out here the other day and was helped by Jaclynn who was really busy and still managed to help me in good time. The food was great and I appreciated Jaclynn's hospitality. Will be back for sure

My good friend from los angeles has been raving about this place forever. I was super excited to finally try it and had relatively high expectations. We ordered a whole chicken with two large bowls of pho for take out. Sadly to say, I was so disappointed with the chicken! It was super chewy like rubber. I don't know if it was overcooked or reheated but either way I was very disappointed. The flavors were delicious but texture was a no-no, it made the dish hard to eat. They supposedly steam their chickens fresh as you order but I just felt like that wasn't the case. Their salty pepper lime sauce was on point. I will definitely come back and give it a second chance in the future.
Bottomless mimosas (Pembroke Pines, Florida) was great. Their omelettes and Benedict's are always tasty

Wow, Rise Pies was really exceptional. The mood, the service, the menu. Every item that we have ordered was extremely fresh and flavorful. Staff was extremely nice and helpful in every way possible. You won't regret it.

For maybe the fifth time visiting, I was disappointed in the service. I went on a Friday afternoon, and the bartender, Bobby, seemed like he was going to be on his A-game as I sat down to have a drink during their deceivingly attractive happy hour. However, as the afternoon went on, he seemed to be overwhelmed by the four people that joined me (making it an approximate grand total of 5 customers at the bar). As Bobby walked around in a flustered manner on the other side of the bar behind a wall of liquor, we sat waiting for any acknowledgement whatsoever from him. It never came. We decided we would move outside to a table in a feeble attempt to attract better service. We asked a waitress, who was nice enough, before doing so. 

As we got up, I heard Bobby mutter, "I need a shot." He proceeded to take a shot from a bottle of tequila, which we would have gladly loved to consume if he had offered. Leaving to walk outside, Bobby kindly asked, "I'm just going to combine all of your tabs if that's okay?" I responded, "Sure. No problem." 

My friends and I got comfortable outside while the same waitress brought us some waters...and that's all. We waited for about 20 mins for ANYONE to offer us a menu, a drink, anything, before deciding we had enough of being ignored. 

In the most bizarre manner, the waitress stepped out just as we were leaving cash on the table to say,  "Bye!" 

Needless to say, this was undoubtedly our last visit.

I was a little disappointed with this visit. The staff was friendly, but they talked among themselves more than waiting on tables (2 total tables). I had to bring my cup up and ask for more water, and I ordered some Queso and didn't get any chips with it, so I had to ask for those too. The food was just, eh. I ordered the Chimichanga and split it with my 9 year old. It was very hot (temperature), but not that good. The menu was limited, and on a brochure. It had a kids menu, and the usual most people order. The decor was tasteful. Small inside with around 15 tables. Bathroom was one stall and small. I just didn't care for the service or food. Maybe it was an off day, but I don't think I'll be going back.
I have never had an issue and food is consistently tasty and always exactly what I ordered. Glad to have them in Indy!

One of the best places for wings/chicken in the New Orleans area! The wings are always fresh and hot. This place is always my go to spot whenever I have home parties or events. Also get their extra spicy we go sauce!!!

if we had an option to leave 0 stars, i would be more than happy to do that to say the least. waited 30 minutes to be asked what i want to drink and don't even get me started on us trying to get our meal. took them 5 tries to attempt to bring out our food but had it incorrect every single time and forced my girlfriend to eat a meal she didn't even order and they ended up not even attempting to bring my meal to me. Overall worst experience i've ever had in my entire eating life.

I was visiting friends and we went to Bacon for brunch. The food was really good and waiters friendly and helpful. 

I think the most stressful part of the experience was the noise, the chaos of figuring out how to order then find a table. If you go with just adults you should be fine but add kids into the mix and things feel chaotic.

Solid sandwiches and Covid-awareness.

Placed an order for pickup and it was ready in 15 minutes. Got the grilled, Hopi chicken sandwich. Their sourdough is delicious, slightly toasted with a soft and cheery texture. Any sandwich with bacon and avocado is set up for immediate success.

They require masks to enter the building and have tape on the floor delineating 6 feet of distance between customers. Hand sanitizer at the entrance, plexiglass between the cashier and customer, and you swipe your own credit card when you make the purchase.

Would definitely make a repeat visit.
